title: Polynomial coordinate-subspace ring, ideal and ideal sheaf
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $a,b\geq0$. Define $A=R[x_1,\ldots,x_a,y_1,\ldots,y_b]=\operatorname{MvPolynomial}(\operatorname{Fin}(a)\sqcup\operatorname{Fin}(b),R)$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], with $x_i$ the variables in the first summand and $y_j$ those in the second. Define the coordinate-subspace ideal $J=(y_1,\ldots,y_b)\subseteq A$. On $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], define its quasi-coherent ideal sheaf $\widetilde J$ to be the ideal sheaf of the closed immersion $\operatorname{Spec}(A/J)\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Equivalently, use the canonical identification $A\cong\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}A,\mathcal O)$ to transport $J$ into the global sections, then restrict and extend this ideal to every affine open. Empty coordinate sets are allowed; in particular, $b=0$ gives $J=0$.
